description: Three people in dark fur clothing sit around a stone-ringed fire in a dim hut with animal skulls and a large curved bone behind them. The man in front holds a small clay figurine over the flames with a wooden tool. Smaller clay animal and human figurines sit on stone slabs in the foreground, and pine branches lie by the fire. The painting is dark and painterly, fills the frame edge to edge, and shows no visible text.
